units: <cite ref="Gittin 56a:17">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>בעו למִדְקְרֵיה</he> (the guardsmen) wanted to stab his body (to see whether R. Joḥ. was really dead).

<cite ref="Gittin 56a:17">Ib.</cite> (Hebr.) <he>יאמרו רבן דָּקְרוּ</he> they (the Romans) will say, they stabbed their teacher. [<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 47:5">Ex. R. s. 47</cite> <he>ודקרין</he>, v. <cite ref="S02019"><he>קְרֵי</he></cite>.]
